summary: Requested a second execution, this time for the node-layer claim that is still source-only. The harness drives pendingReadIndex directly in the root package: a read is registered with a five-tick timeout, dequeued into a batch under a fresh SystemCtx with no ready-to-read index, the logical clock advances past the deadline, and one applied(0) call is delivered as an event-loop iteration would, checking whether the request's completed channel receives RequestTimeout or nothing. No conclusions asserted before the receipt; the experiment is fixed for isolated execution and declares that only the request object, queue and clock are involved.
